kubeclaw.artifact-store.usage: Provider artifacts.read/write; Core-AdapterStarter/Namespacegrant; SDK source-revision exact read und Core/Plugins artifact puts.

kubeclaw.command-runner.usage: Provider command.execute über Core; außerdem exportierter CommandRunner direkt im Buster DirectCommandCapabilityInvoker.

kubeclaw.git-workspace.usage: Provider git.workspace.create/remove, git.commit/merge/sync; Blueprint-Sync Sender und GitRunner/Filesystem/Remote geprüft.

kubeclaw.network-http.usage: Provider network.http; runtime-dispatch/OpenClaw nutzen confidential HTTP via Core-Grants und exakte Originallowlist.

kubeclaw.secret-resolver.usage: Provider secrets.read; Core erzwingt allowedNames und confidential-Aufruf, runtime-dispatch empfängt value transient.

kubeclaw.runtime-dispatch.usage: Alternative runtime/openclaw Provider für runtime.dispatch; Review und Prism-Gegenstellen, Core-/Network-/Secret-/Repo-Grenzen geprüft.

kubeclaw.wait-store.usage: Provider signal.wait; human-approval create, Core besitzt Resume/Issuer/Expiry; Store persistiert nur Waitintent.
kubeclaw.wait-store.responsibility: Idempotente dauerhafte validierte Wait-Requests ohne Resumeautorität.

prism.studio.usage: index.html → app.tsx React/Puck; Production Session/Control APIs und RevisionRepository.apply, DEV lokale Fixture; preview Originalrenderer.
prism.studio.responsibility: Browsereditor, verlustarme typed-operation Übersetzung, isolierte Vorschau und Approval-/Revision-UI.
